papers.title: A fast tangential rational Krylov subspace method with randomized sketching for large Lyapunov matrix equations
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2611.33684v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: We propose a tangential rational Krylov subspace method augmented with randomized sketching for solving continuous-time Lyapunov equations $AX + XA^T + BB^T = 0$, where $A$ is large and sparse and $B$ has a rank much higher than one. Numerical solutions require high-dimensional rational Krylov subspaces (e.g., of dimensions up to $\sim 1000$), leading to substantial computational cost and long runtime.
